description: Todo 9 submission-decision state. User updates rank_100_cutoff / date_captured / current_best_public_score after checking the LIVE DACON leaderboard (https://dacon.io/competitions/official/236743/leaderboard). This file IS a commit target (small config).
rank_100_cutoff_note: LIVE rank-100 cutoff (USER-CONFIRMED from the leaderboard). Plan TL;DR value 1066.47756 is HISTORICAL reference only - never hardcode. Unknown = BLOCK (cutoff_unknown).
date_captured_note: ISO timestamp when rank_100_cutoff was captured on the live leaderboard. Must be within 24h TTL of a check run, else BLOCK (cutoff_stale).
current_best_public_score_note: Champion V4 measured Public 979.31 (provenance.json champion_rollback.note, real measurement). Update to the best REAL public score when it changes.
qualified_candidate_public_score_note: Public score of the qualified candidate (champ_cat) IF already submitted - leave null until a real score is reported.
allow_below_cutoff_note: Explicit override to permit submission when target margin <= 0. Default false; set true only with user intent.
submissions_by_date_note: One entry per local calendar day (Asia/Seoul): {YYYY-MM-DD: count}. Runner enforces DAILY_SUBMISSION_LIMIT=1. Add a row AFTER a real submission (user action).
last_submission_note: {date, file_model, public_score, verdict} of the most recent real submission - user fills after DACON returns a score.
qualified_package_note: Registered by: python3 repro_979/submission_decision.py --register-qualified (after Todo 8 PASS). Holds candidate_id / qualification_digest / package_validated.
